details.summary: Ram107 applied the isolated DHCP lease, accepted a temporary gateway/DNS test event, removed that state on real renewal, preserved rescue SSH through lease-loss cleanup, and returned to stock.
hardware_checks: Real DHCP bound and renewed 10.77.10.10/24 from 10.77.10.1
Temporary RAM event installed default route via 10.77.10.1 metric 100 and two resolver entries; interactive SSH output was observed but not saved as a raw command log
Real DHCP renewal from the unchanged server cleared that route and resolver file
Deconfig removed the managed address while preserving 10.77.10.11/24; rescue SSH stayed connected
A later real renewal restored the managed address with no route or DNS
Qt started once; no display blank/unblank or Qt restart was requested
eMMC stayed read-only and the nowayout watchdog kept feeding
details.recovery: One-shot U-Boot restored factory p8 before RAM kernel handoff; requested reboot returned stock in 36.8 seconds, with exact p8 and approved ADC postflight.
limitations: The isolated DHCP server advertises no router/DNS; live route/DNS handling was tested by a temporary script event, not by a server-supplied option.
DNS resolution and arbitrary production leases remain untested.
CPU1/SMP, power and suspend policy, remote cores and full-image eMMC boot remain pending; 3D remains parked.
